product_metadata.title: New Vintage Wood Hanging Wall Sign Two Old Crabs Live Here Distressed Plaque Cozy Beach Cottage Decor Art
features: Great for a housewarming gift, or for the couple that's been together forever!
Made of wood with rope attached
description: Here is a cute hanging plaque featuring the phrase Two Old Crabs Live Here accented by, you guessed it, two old crabs! Their bright red color contrasts beautifully with the distressed blue background of this sign. This wall art is sure to add cozy beach cottage charm to your home's decor! This sign measures 9.5 by 5.5 inches, is made of wood, and hangs easily via a rope attached.
